description: This file contains unit tests for Azure Storage error code handling and validation functions, specifically testing the behavior of AzureTableUtils and AzureBlobUtils utility methods within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: AzureTableErrorCodeTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for Azure Storage error handling and name validation utilities.

methods.name: AzureTableErrorCode_IsRetriableHttpError
methods.description: Tests whether certain HTTP status codes are correctly identified as retriable errors.

methods.name: AzureTableErrorCode_IsContentionError
methods.description: Tests whether specific HTTP status codes are correctly identified as contention errors.

methods.name: AzureTableErrorCode_BadTableName
methods.description: Tests validation of a table name that should throw an ArgumentException.

methods.name: AzureStorageUtils_ContainerName
methods.description: Tests container name validation, expecting exceptions for invalid names and success for valid names.

methods.name: AzureStorageUtils_BlobName
methods.description: Tests blob name validation, expecting exceptions for invalid names and success for valid names.

methods.name: AzureStorageUtils_TablePropertyShouldBeSanitized
methods.description: Tests sanitization of table property strings to ensure invalid characters are replaced.
